thresholds_fy2026_27.tsmit_history_note: FY2023-24 TSMIT $70,000; raised to $73,150 under LIN 24/052 (2024-07-01 to 2024-12-06) before SID CSIT replacement
thresholds_fy2026_27.family_ppp_basis: FCFCOA Family Law Practice Direction: Priority Property Pool Cases (fam-ppp) para 3.1(a) (< $550,000 net ex-super) & para 3.1(b) (court discretion)

deadlines.s116_noicc_basis: Migration Regulations 1994 reg 2.44(2)(a) (onshore; offshore reg 2.44(2)(b); discretionary +5 working days before expiry under s 121(4) & reg 2.44(3))
deadlines.s116_art_review_basis: Migration Act 1958 s 347(3)(b) & s 347(5) (general Part 5 non-detention 28 calendar days; non-extendable)
deadlines.detention_art_review_basis: Migration Act 1958 s 347(3)(a) & s 347(5) (in immigration detention on the day notified; non-extendable)
deadlines.s501ca_basis: Migration Act 1958 s 501CA(4) & reg 2.52(2)(b) · Direction No. 123
deadlines.s500_character_art_basis: Migration Act 1958 s 500(6B) (onshore character expedited; excludes ART Act ss 18, 19 extensions while AIA s 36(2) applies per [2026] FCA 250 / [2026] ARTA 1052; preceding-business-day lodgement recommended)
deadlines.fcfcoa_judicial_review_basis: Migration Act 1958 s 477(1), (2) & (3) (runs from date of migration decision, not deemed postal receipt; court extension possible)
deadlines.offshore_sponsor_art_basis: Migration Act 1958 s 347(3)(b) & s 347(5) (standing per s 347(2) & reg 4.02)
deadlines.fwc_dismissal_basis: Fair Work Act 2009 ss 394(2)-(3), 366(1)-(2), 536LU (strict 21 days; FWC extension only if exceptional circumstances) & Acts Interpretation Act 1901 s 36(2)

fees_aud.art_fee_indexing_basis: Migration Regulations 1994 reg 4.13A (annual CPI indexing each 1 July)
fees_aud.art_standard_migration_basis: Migration Regulations 1994 reg 4.13(1) ($3,727 FY2026-27), reg 4.13(4) (discretionary 50% severe financial hardship reduction to $1,863.50 for Part 5 general migration ONLY), reg 4.14 (50% favourable outcome refund)
fees_aud.art_protection_fee_basis: Migration Amendment (2026 Measures No. 1) Regulations 2026 (F2026L01448) reg 4.31B(1) (50% of reg 4.13(1) indexed under reg 4.13A = $1,863.50 upfront in FY2026-27 for ART applications lodged on/after 1 Nov 2026 per Sch 13 cl 16501); reg 4.31B(2)(a)-(b) upfront fee nil ONLY if in immigration detention or validly combined under reg 4.31A with an already-paid application (NO financial hardship waiver); reg 4.31B(3) 100% refund on favourable outcome (regs 4.31BA-4.31C repealed by F2026L01448 Sch 1 Item 2)
